title: Check approved routes for a Restricted Access Vehicle
summary: Use an online map to plan and check approved routes for Restricted Access Vehicles (RAV) operating in NSW.
intro:
If you operate a Restricted Access Vehicle (RAV), you can use an interactive online map to plan your route in NSW.

You can check the approved routes for the following vehicles:

The map shows approved areas and routes, low-clearance bridges, and restrictions by heavy vehicle type. The approved routes are the legally enforceable network in NSW.
